descriptions.f17b_query_8020b460: Queries an inferred interface map made of12-byte external entries: optional16-byte comparison key, signed object-byte adjustment, and32-bit callback/sentinel. A null output pointer returns0x80004003; otherwise clears it. Comparing requested key with external16-byte key8040c950 through802eedc0 selects the first entry adjustment directly. Otherwise scans until callback0, accepts wildcard key0 or equal16-byte key, treats callback1 as a direct adjusted interface, and invokes other callbacks with original receiver,key,output,adjustment. Returns callback0 or a negative result from a keyed entry; wildcard failures continue. Direct selection invokes observed virtual slot12 on the adjusted external receiver, stores its pointer and returns0. Exhaustion returns0x80004002. A shared result exit preserves original callback result lifetime. Names,query semantics,GUID interpretation,callback signature and complete external receiver layout remain inferred. All entries,comparison key and target object are external partial views; no type is locally constructed or allocated, no owned data or compiler-option override.
